command.cde.help.title: --- CDE Commands ---
command.cde.help.portal: /cde portal [config_id|ui] [color_hex] - Give yourself a portal (e.g. /cde portal ui FF0000)
command.cde.help.join: /cde join [config_id] - Open the join UI or join an unlocked dungeon directly
command.cde.help.unlock: /cde unlock <player> <config_id> - Manually unlock a dungeon for a player
command.cde.help.config_create: /cde config create <id> - Create a new dungeon configuration
command.cde.help.config_edit: /cde config edit <id> - Open the config editor UI
command.cde.help.config_export: /cde config export <id> - Export a config to a JSON file
command.cde.help.config_import: /cde config import <id> - Import a config from a JSON file
command.cde.help.cleanup_broken: /cde cleanup broken - Find and cache broken active dungeons
command.cde.help.cleanup_all: /cde cleanup all - Cache all active dungeons for wiping
command.cde.help.cleanup_list: /cde cleanup list [page] - View the cached pending cleanups
command.cde.help.cleanup_confirm: /cde cleanup confirm - Delete all cached pending cleanups
command.cde.help.cleanup_delete: /cde cleanup delete <uuid> - Delete a specific pending cleanup
